title: Roof Replacement in Gresham, OR
summary: In September 2024, French Roofing replaced the roof on a home in Gresham, OR. The crew tore off the old shingles down to the wood deck, laid Safeguard 30 synthetic underlayment and 24 inch valley metal, and installed new CertainTeed Landmark shingles with new attic vents and flashings.
scope: Tore off all layers of old roofing down to the wood deck
Installed Safeguard 30 synthetic underlayment over the deck
New painted drip edge and gable flashing, plus a self-sealing starter course
Installed 24 inch metal in the valleys
Installed CertainTeed Landmark shingles with standard ridge cap
New front wall and sidewall flashing, new power pole flashing and new double-seal vent pipe flashings
Replaced the attic vents with new plastic vents
Cleaned out the gutters, hauled away the debris and ran a magnet over the yard
body: Before the work started, moss had grown into the gaps between the old shingles. The photos below show the old roof, the new underlayment, and the new shingles going on.
